question:
Select the Venn diagram from the given options that best represents the relationship between the given set of classes.

Prose, Literature and Poetry
solution:
• The relationship between Prose, Literature and Poetry is as follows.

i) All Prose are Literature.

ii) All Poetry are Literature.

iii) No Poetry is Prose.
